caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition with a white or light beige background. Across the upper section of the rectangle are two wide, green swags with a subtle dotted or textured pattern, draped in a curved manner from left to right, meeting near the center and splaying out toward the sides. At each end and at the center point where the swags dip downward, the green fabric is gathered and adorned with large, stylized bows in bright red. Extending down from each bow are two elongated red shapes resembling tassels or decorative tails. The composition consists primarily of these green and red elements set against the neutral background, and a small inscription “CHARLOTTE ANGUS” is located near the bottom right corner.
title: Valance for Tester
